ai_language_tip: 用歐洲葡語詞（telemóvel、marcação），不要套巴西的 'você' 或 'celular'；安哥拉、莫三比克口音與用詞和里斯本不同，對方改用克里奧爾語時不要硬轉，改回葡語或請店家改用葡語。
english_ok: sometimes — 維德角薩爾、博阿維斯塔與馬普托、羅安達旅館較常聽懂英語；內陸市鎮與幾內亞比索、聖多美多數店家仍以葡語為主。
politeness: 開場用 Bom dia / Boa tarde 加 o senhor / a senhora；莫三比克與安哥拉也常用 irmão、chefe 作客氣稱呼，但代訂時仍用第三人稱。結尾 muito obrigado(a)。
name_tip: 報名用一個名加一個姓即可（如 Manuel Costa、Amina dos Santos）；葡語複合姓較長時，先報訂位時用的那個姓再逐字拼。
phone_tip: 安哥拉全國 9 位、市話以 2 開頭、手機多為 9 開頭（923 123 456）；莫三比克手機常寫 84 123 4567，馬普托市話 21 開頭；維德角與聖多美為 7 位；幾內亞比索手機 9 開頭。國際冠碼 +244 / +258 / +245 / +238 / +239。朗讀請分組，不要連念。
time_tip: 書面多用 24 小時（19h、19:30）；口語「sete e meia da noite」。區內晚餐多在 19:00 前後，比里斯本早，不要逕自改成 20h30。
number_tip: 數字用歐洲葡語：6 說 seis（不要說巴西的 meia）；16/17/19 用 dezasseis、dezassete、dezanove。金額先講貨幣：安哥拉 kwanza、莫三比克 metical、維德角 escudo。
avoid_calling: 避開午餐約 12:00–15:00、晚餐高峰 19:00–20:30，以及平日 18:30 後打給政府與小作坊；週日上午許多店休或只做彌撒時段。
closed_days: 各國獨立日不同（安哥拉 11 月 11 日、莫三比克 6 月 25 日、維德角 7 月 5 日等）；耶誕、新年、耶穌受難日常見公休。維德角旅遊島飯店多全日營業，市區小館則常週日休息。
booking_channels: 多數餐廳、診所與維修是電話加 WhatsApp；羅安達有人試用 OCULHA 訂位（查證時官網回 503，不能當成穩定通路）。馬普托外送有本地 App（如 TáAqui，可付 M-Pesa／e-Mola），維德角普拉亞有 Deliiv。旅館常用 Booking.com。安哥拉市區出行可見 Yango。
voice_menu: 銀行、Unitel／Movicel、Vodacom Moçambique（含 M-Pesa）與部分政府熱線有按鍵語音；街邊餐館和診所櫃台多直接接聽。
callback_habits: 小店幾乎都用 WhatsApp 回覆與確認；診所有時改發短訊；旅館與航空相關多電郵加 WhatsApp。不要假設會再打電話回來。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 羅安達、馬普托熱門館常用 WhatsApp 或電話留桌，晚餐約 19:00；不要套用葡萄牙 TheFork。維德角旅遊島也可問飯店代訂。
usually_asked: Date and sitting hour (almoço around 12:30 vs jantar around 19:00, earlier than in Portugal)
Party size and whether a cadeira de bebé is needed
Indoor sala versus esplanada or quintal
Name and a local mobile in that country's format
Whether payment will be Multicaixa (Angola), M-Pesa (Mozambique) or cash

may_come_up.what: Restaurant asks for a Multicaixa or M-Pesa payment to 'secure' the table to a personal number
Only cash or a local debit network, no foreign card
Wants the booking under a hotel name on Sal or in Maputo

sensitive_asked.what: Demands an immediate transfer to an unlabelled personal wallet before any confirmation

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公私診所多半電話或 WhatsApp 掛號，很少統一預約 App；要問保險或現金、以及要看的科別。
usually_asked: Whether the visit is a first consulta or a return / exam follow-up
Patient's full name as on the identity document and a callback number
Preferred morning or afternoon slot
Cash, insurance or a company account

may_come_up.what: Clinic only takes walk-in numbers on the day and will not pre-book
Asks which document to bring (BI, passaporte or cartão de utente)

sensitive_asked.what: Requests a medical history or test result to be read out in full on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊與指甲店幾乎都靠 WhatsApp 約時間，電話能打通也常被轉去訊息確認造型與時長。
usually_asked: Service type (cabelo, unhas, barba, tranças) and roughly how long
Date and hour, plus an alternative if the stylist is booked
Name and WhatsApp number used for the reminder

may_come_up.what: Stylist is known only by a first name and works from home
A deposit via Multicaixa or M-Pesa is requested for a bridal booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for a photo ID to be sent to a private chat before any appointment is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車、手機與冷氣行多半電話先問有沒有零件，再約人到店或上門；確認多用 WhatsApp 傳照片。
usually_asked: What is broken and the make or model if known
Bring-in versus a visit at the compound or office
When the owner can leave the item or receive the technician

may_come_up.what: Workshop is on generator only in the evening and wants a morning drop-off
Quote will be sent as a WhatsApp voice note rather than a written price

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for a remote 'diagnostic fee' to a personal Multicaixa before seeing the device

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶多直接打電話或 WhatsApp 點餐；馬普托可試 TáAqui，維德角普拉亞可試 Deliiv，其他城市常是店家自己送。
usually_asked: Dishes and quantities, including spicy level if it is a local plate (muamba, matapa, cachupa)
Collection time versus delivery to a bairro or predio
Name and a number the rider can call at the gate

may_come_up.what: Delivery is only inside one city district and not to the next bairro
Payment on delivery must be cash or M-Pesa, not a foreign card

sensitive_asked.what: Rider asks to be paid into a different personal wallet than the shop named

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 電器與布料店常接受 WhatsApp 問存貨再留貨；較少購物車結帳，電話只為確認型號與取貨日。
usually_asked: Exact model, size or fabric and how many
Collect in store versus informal delivery
Name to put on the set-aside goods

may_come_up.what: Item is in another city and would be sent by coach or candongueiro-style cargo
Shop can only reserve until close of the next business day

sensitive_asked.what: Requests a full bank transfer to a private account to 'lock' stock sight unseen

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多半回到原 WhatsApp 對話或再打電話，說原時間與名字即可；旅遊島餐廳取消規則較嚴。
usually_asked: Original date, hour and the name the booking is under
The new time that would work, or that it should be cancelled
Party size if that also changes

may_come_up.what: Venue says a no-show fee was already agreed for a weekend table
Only the person who sent the first WhatsApp can change it

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for an extra transfer to 'process the change' before any new slot is noted

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問營業、能不能刷卡或有沒有某道菜，直接打或傳 WhatsApp 最快；不要只依賴過時網頁。
usually_asked: The concrete question (hours, Multicaixa or M-Pesa, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to come if it affects the answer
A number if the shop will reply after checking the kitchen or storeroom

may_come_up.what: Answer differs by country: Multicaixa is Angola-centric, M-Pesa is common in Mozambique
Staff prefer to reply in a voice note on WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: Unknown caller asks the owner to read out card or wallet PINs to 'verify' a booking

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 旅遊島與羅安達、馬普托飯店常用 Booking.com 或官網，小旅館則 WhatsApp 問空房；入住時多半還要再傳護照照片。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and how many guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number
Payment: bank transfer, Multicaixa or cash at arrival

may_come_up.what: Property on Sal or Boa Vista is listed on Booking.com and wants the same reference
Generator hours or water cuts are mentioned for an inland guesthouse

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for a scan of the passport and a transfer to a personal account before any written confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 跳島、沙灘活動與國家公園導覽多經旅遊社或 WhatsApp 訂，小團常要先付訂金；天氣不佳會改期。
usually_asked: Which tour or activity and the date, including a weather backup
Number of adults and children and pickup point (hotel or jetty)
Name and a mobile that works on the island

may_come_up.what: Boat leaves only if a minimum number of guests is reached
Park or island fee is cash-only on arrival

sensitive_asked.what: Operator demands a full prepaid transfer with no company name or receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣與清潔多靠熟人或 WhatsApp 約上門；要講清 bairro、門牌與是否有門房。
usually_asked: The job (ar condicionado, canalização, limpeza) and preferred visit window
Bairro, building and how the technician is let in
Name and a number that will answer at the gate

may_come_up.what: Technician will only quote after seeing a photo on WhatsApp
Access depends on a porteiro or condomínio pass

sensitive_asked.what: Someone asks for the door code and a remote prepayment before any visit is scheduled

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫與寵物美容在大城市用電話或 WhatsApp 預約，小城鎮常是當日到場抽號，要說明動物種類與疫苗。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
Whether it is a first visit or a vaccination follow-up
Owner name and a reachable mobile

may_come_up.what: Clinic sees animals only in the morning before the heat
Proof of rabies vaccine may be asked for a boarding stay

sensitive_asked.what: Requests payment to a personal wallet to 'reserve a kennel' with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 跨國與國內包裹常要打電話或 WhatsApp 問轉運站，單號格式因物流而異；不要套用歐美快遞 App 的流程。
usually_asked: Waybill or reference and the destination city
Name on the parcel and a local contact number
Whether collection is at a depot or a home in a named bairro

may_come_up.what: Parcel is waiting in Luanda or Maputo and needs a local pick-up authorisation
Duty or a cash on-delivery balance is due in kwanza or metical

sensitive_asked.what: A message asks for a wallet top-up to 'release' a parcel the caller cannot identify

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、Unitel、Vodacom 與 M-Pesa／Multicaixa 客服用電話加語音選單，要先備妥合約或錢包號碼，不要在電話裡報密碼。
usually_asked: Which company and the account, SIM or wallet label
The problem in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: IVR is in Portuguese only and English is not offered
They ask the customer to go to an agência with the BI

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for the Multicaixa PIN, M-Pesa PIN or one-time code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 羅安達可用 Yango 叫車，不必先打電話；其他城市仍多靠街邊的士或 WhatsApp 約熟司機。機場接送常由旅館代叫。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (bairro, hotel or airport) and the time
How many passengers and bags
A number the driver can call on arrival at the gate

may_come_up.what: Yango or a similar app is available in the city, so a phone dispatch is unnecessary
Road to the airport may need an earlier set-off in rain or peak hours

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for a full prepayment to a personal wallet before sharing any plate number

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房多經仲介或房東 WhatsApp 約時間，要帶身份證明；描述地址時用 bairro 與地標，不要只報一個門牌數字。
usually_asked: Viewing time and whether it is rent or sale
Name and a number the agent can call at the gate
Budget currency (kwanza, metical or escudo) if asked

may_come_up.what: Agent wants a copy of the BI before opening the door
Building has a condomínio fee that is not in the listed rent

sensitive_asked.what: Someone demands a reservation fee into a personal account before any accompanied visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公立單位與學校窗口常要本人到場取號，電話多只能問文件與開放時間；語氣用正式葡語。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose (certidão, matrícula, visa support)
The person's name as on the BI or passport
Whether a number is drawn only in person and at which hour

may_come_up.what: Many services require the applicant to appear with originals, and the phone only confirms the checklist
A lunch shutdown around 12:00–14:30 is common at municipal counters

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from a ministry asks for a wallet payment to 'speed up' a file
